about_the_game:
This world is full of monsters that want to kill you. Your mission is to survive, but pay attention and keep you heart and sould under controll, because - you can become a new monster of this place.

This is typical Survivor Rogue Like game.
Plying this variant of game you will find next interesting points:

1) Comon skill system ( each hero has 10-20 skills that dont make special combo. You dont need guides, youtube video or knowledge in the chemistry. Skills are simple and clear enough. But to win you have to choose a right strategy , taking into account the random way skills come.  Some skills are very usefull , some are not ,even if they look so. Some of them need to be learned once, other need to maximize. Anyway it wont be easy , if you are not a genius)

2) 3 different heroes with different skills and controlls , what creates cause to change your fight strategy and get new experience. Game wont be the same.

3) Retro style of the game but in 3D variant.

4) Posability to get your best score and overcome your own limit. Become best variant of you.
